answer_1.quote: We evaluate performance of our method on end-to-end dialogue modeling task of Multi-woz2.0 ... The results are tabulated ...

answer_2.quote: We use three evaluations metrics proposed by ... 1) inform ... 2) success rate ... 3) BLEU ... We also report the combined score (Inform + Success) × 0.5 + BLEU.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation on the quality of the generated response ... We define quality by the following criterias: 1) Appropriateness ... 2) Fluency ... The human evaluators were shown context ... asked to give a score between 1 and 5.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rate each response on Appropriateness and Fluency on a 1‑5 scale given the dialogue context.
